title: Why a Damaged QR Code Still Scans (Error Correction)
description:
A QR code stores backup data on purpose (Reed-Solomon error correction, the same math used for music CDs), so it can still scan with part of it missing.
The 25% and 30% figures are shares of the code's data, not visible area, and the QR pattern shown is a drawn, non-decodable illustration.
Original animation by ervenderr.
Narration is a synthetic voice (VoiceStudio). Animation is written as code.
